日.cue: A window around the sun: 日 can mean both sun and day.

contrasts.note: 日 has one inner horizontal line, 目 has two. Compare sun/day with eye.

国.cue: Picture a country enclosed by its borders.

人.cue: Two strokes stand like a person's two legs.

contrasts.note: The diagonal strokes meet differently. Compare 人 (person) with 入る (enter); trace each starting stroke.

年.cue: Use 年 for a year; contrast it with 月 for a month.

大.cue: A person stretches their arms wide: big. Compare 小, small.

十.cue: Two crossing strokes form ten. Add 一 after it for eleven.

二.cue: Two horizontal strokes, with the lower line longer.

本.cue: A mark near the root of 木 changes tree into 本. Learn it here as book.

中.cue: A line passes through the middle of a box.

長.cue: Learn 長い as long: keep the kana い when you write the word.

出.cue: Picture something coming out. 出る means to go or come out.

三.cue: Three horizontal strokes; keep the middle one short.

時.cue: The 日 side connects this character with time. 時間 is time or hours.

行.cue: Learn 行く as go. Its opposite in this course is 来る, come.

見.cue: An eye above two legs: look and see.

月.cue: Two short lines inside the moon. 月 can also count months.

分.cue: 分かる means to understand; 分 also appears in minutes and parts.

後.cue: Think of what comes after, or is behind. Contrast 前.

前.cue: In front, or before. Contrast 後, behind or after.

生.cue: Life and growth: 生まれる means to be born.

五.cue: A compact five. Practise it beside 四 and 六.

間.cue: The sun 日 appears between the doors 門: a space between.

contrasts.note: Inside 門, 間 has 日 and 問 has 口. Compare 間 (space between) with 問題 (question or problem).

上.cue: The short stroke sits above the baseline. Compare 下.

東.cue: Learn this as east, where the sun rises. Compare 西, west.

四.cue: Four has a box around its inner strokes. Read it as よん or し.

今.cue: Now: use 今 for the present moment, not this year or today alone.

金.cue: Gold and metal; in お金 it means money.

九.cue: Nine has a distinctive curved hook. Compare 力 later.

入.cue: Two strokes come together to enter. Compare 人, person.

contrasts.note: The diagonal strokes meet differently. Compare 人 (person) with 入る (enter); trace each starting stroke.

学.cue: A child 子 under a roof: picture learning at school.

高.cue: A tall building stacked upward: high or tall.

子.cue: Picture a child with arms out. 子供 means children or a child.

六.cue: A little roof over two legs: six. Keep it distinct from 八.

下.cue: The short stroke hangs below the baseline. Compare 上.

来.cue: 来る means come. Compare 行く, go; the whole words sound different.

気.cue: In 天気, 気 helps make the word weather; in 元気 it relates to energy.

小.cue: Three small strokes: small. Compare 大, big.

七.cue: Seven has a stroke that turns upward. Learn なな and しち as readings of 七.

話.cue: The speech side 言 signals speaking. 話す means to talk.

女.cue: Learn 女 as woman. Compare 男, man.

北.cue: North. Use it with 南, south, to build your compass.

午.cue: 午前 is before noon; 午後 is after noon. Compare 牛, cow, later.

contrasts.note: The vertical stroke in 牛 extends above the upper horizontal. Compare 牛肉 (beef) with 午前 (morning).

百.cue: One hundred: the white-looking shape is 白 with another line above.

書.cue: Picture stacked lines of writing. 書く means to write.

先.cue: Ahead or before. A 先生 is someone who went ahead: a teacher.

名.cue: Your name: learn it in 名前.

川.cue: Three streams flow downward to form a river.

千.cue: A slanting stroke above 十 turns ten into thousand.

contrasts.note: 千 begins with a slanted stroke; 干 has a horizontal top stroke. Compare 千 (thousand) with 干す (dry).

水.cue: Water spreads outward from the middle stroke.

半.cue: Half. 半分 repeats the idea of a divided part.

男.cue: A field 田 above strength 力 is a memory hook for man, not a rule about people.

西.cue: West, where the sun sets. Contrast 東, east.

電.cue: The rain-shaped top appears in 電: electricity. 電車 is a train.

無.cue: Absence: 無理 describes something unreasonable or impossible.

校.cue: The tree-shaped side 木 appears in 校. Learn the whole word 学校, school.

語.cue: Speech 言 on the left: 日本語 is the Japanese language.

土.cue: Two horizontal strokes crossed by a vertical one: earth or soil.

contrasts.note: In 土 the lower horizontal stroke is longer. In 士 the upper one is longer. Compare soil with the character in 博士.

木.cue: A trunk, branches and roots form a tree.

聞.cue: An ear 耳 inside a doorway 門: listen and hear.

食.cue: Learn 食べる as eat; keep べる after the kanji.

車.cue: Picture a wheel and axle. 車 is a car or vehicle.

何.cue: What? Learn 何 as a question, with readings なに and なん depending on the phrase.

南.cue: South. Pair it with 北, north.

万.cue: Ten thousand, not one thousand. Compare 千.

毎.cue: Every. 毎日 means every day.

白.cue: White: compare it with 日, sun, and 百, hundred.

天.cue: The sky above a person 大: heaven or sky.

母.cue: The two dots help distinguish mother from related box shapes.

火.cue: Picture flames rising around a central stroke.

右.cue: Right contains 口, a mouth-shaped box. Compare 左.

contrasts.note: Both end in 口. Notice the first two strokes above it: 右 is right, 石 is stone.

読.cue: The speech side 言 appears again. 読む means to read.

友.cue: Think of helping hands: a friend. Learn the word 友達.

左.cue: Left contains 工. Compare the inner part of 右, right.

休.cue: A person 亻 rests beside a tree 木.

父.cue: Father. Learn it alongside 母, mother.

雨.cue: Drops fall beneath a roof: rain.

丈.cue: In 大丈夫, learn the whole word だいじょうぶ, all right; don't guess it from the parts.

誰.cue: Who? The speech side 言 helps connect this with asking about a person.

貼.cue: 貼る means to stick or paste something onto a surface.
